transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As you know, the business team wants to get this NimbusGrid agreement signed this month so the migration can stay on schedule. Before I approve, I need both of you to walk me through any required changes to the vendor draft. Specifically, I want to hear from privacy counsel on the data processing provisions — the draft currently permits processing in any country where NimbusGrid operates and only requires 30 days' notice of a security incident. And commercial transactions counsel, I need your take on the $500,000 aggregate liability cap and any other commercial terms that need redlining. What are you seeing?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed a data-map review yesterday and confirmed that the platform will process EU employee health information. The review requires hosting only in the European Economic Area, security-incident notice within 72 hours, and a vendor deletion certificate within 30 days after termination. I had not yet circulated this review before this meeting.
